comment: files.c read_wizkit() -> fopen_wizkit_file() in debug mode with WIZKIT naming no file: C raw_printf()s "Access to <name> denied (2)." and wait_synch()s before the welcome. The raw print is the first, so recorder patch 006's nomux_enter_raw_mode() blanks the shadow screen; C's gg.gbuf still holds the map, so the map stays blank until docorner() redraws the corner under the inventory menu, while moveloop_preamble()'s full status redraw restores both status rows. The later WIZKIT statement replaces the first (cnf_line_WIZKIT()). Seed, date, Tourist and kit names chosen independently.
